thesis: Hold QQQ, IWM, and NVDA. Cash is $0, so any buy is a sale of one of those lines. Summaries are empty, so that is a price headline, not a reason to liquidate QQQ or NVDA into cash. I will not sell NVDA to buy AAPL or AMD on those items, and AMD has no open. A $760 billion AI risk, two monster stocks, five dividend stocks, five bear-market ETFs, and a dividend ETF beating the S&P are unnamed. COST, TJX, AFRM, AMAT, CASY, GSK, GRAB, VZ, OLLI, SBUX, and SpaceX have no open or are not listed. Europe's oil-surge line names no US major, so I will not invent XOM. No small-cap item against IWM.
